entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/cart
entities.reasoning: Cart pods entered CrashLoopBackOff because of OOM kills, stopping the cart service.
entities.evidence: Alert "KubePodCrashLooping" firing for cart pods; metric spikes in memory usage; events show OOMKilled.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/cart
entities.reasoning: Service cart lost endpoints when its pods crashed, causing downstream failures.
entities.evidence: ServiceDown alert for cart; downstream services reported connection errors.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkout
entities.reasoning: Checkout depended on cart; requests timed out after cart became unavailable.
entities.evidence: High latency alerts for checkout; trace spans show failed calls to cart.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend returned 5xx errors because checkout could not complete due to missing cart data.
entities.evidence: Alert "HTTP5xx" for frontend; logs contain "checkout failed" messages.

propagations.condition: Cart pods crash and stop serving traffic
propagations.effect: Service cart loses all ready endpoints

propagations.condition: Checkout makes RPC calls to cart service
propagations.effect: Checkout experiences timeouts and high latency

propagations.condition: Frontend calls checkout to complete orders
propagations.effect: Frontend returns HTTP 5xx errors to users

alerts_explained.explanation: Cart pods repeatedly crashed due to OOM, triggering CrashLoopBackOff alerts.
Cart service reported no ready endpoints after its pods crashed.
Checkout pods showed elevated latency because calls to cart timed out.
Frontend service emitted 5xx responses as downstream checkout failures propagated.
